functionalReqs: Browse movies and shows by city
Seat layout per screen with seat types and prices
Lock selected seats for 5 minutes while paying
Confirm or release seats after payment
Cancel a booking with a refund policy
hints: Separate the static layout (Screen, Seat) from per-show availability (ShowSeat).
Where does the lock with expiry live, and who releases it on timeout?

City → Cinema → Screen → Seat; Show (movie, screen, time) → ShowSeat with status (FREE, LOCKED, BOOKED); SeatLockProvider interface (in-memory with ConcurrentHashMap + expiry, or DB); Booking with a state machine; PricingStrategy; PaymentService interface.
nonFunctionalReqs: No double booking under concurrent requests
problemStatement:
Design the classes behind a **movie ticket booking** app: cities, cinemas, screens, shows and seats, with seat selection, temporary holds and payment.

The focus is on class design and making concurrent seat booking safe.
title: Design a Movie Ticket Booking System
